title: 灾难求生
visual: clear geography, escalating environmental state, scarce resources, crowd movement, and visible consequences
performance: specific survival decisions, hesitation, panic control, cooperation or conflict, and aftermath reactions
camera: alternate scale-establishing wides, spatial action, resource inserts, faces, and consequence shots

avoid: random chaos without cause, changing water levels, unclear positions, everyone speaking at once to camera
